content.title: Is Walmart open today? Alabama grocery store hours for Easter Sunday
content.text: April 5, 2026, 4:06 a.m. CTFor shoppers scrambling to grab last-minute Easter essentials, there’s good news: most major retailers are keeping their doors open. Unlike holidays such as Christmas and Thanksgiving, when widespread closures can leave procrastinators out of luck, Easter Sunday has increasingly become a day when many stores remain accessible, offering everything from groceries and candy to décor and dinner fixings.Although some locations may have reduced hours or closures to observe the holiday, overall, consumers can expect a variety of options for their last-minute needs.Here’s what to know about grocery store hours on Easter Sunday 2026 in Alabama.When is Easter 2026?Easter falls today, April 5, 2026. The Christian holiday celebrates the resurrection of Jesus and marks the culmination of Holy Week, a series of observances that includes Palm Sunday, Holy Thursday, Good Friday and finally, Easter Sunday.Will Walmart be open on Easter?Walmart will be open on Easter Sunday during its regular business hours. Walmart only closes on Thanksgiving and Christmas. Will Sam’s Club be open on Easter?Sam’s Club will be closed on Easter Sunday.Is Starbucks open on Easter?Starbucks will be open on Easter Sunday during its regular business hours.Will Target be open on Easter?Target will be closed on Easter Sunday, allowing staff the opportunity to observe the holiday.Will Costco be open on Easter?Costco will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5.Will Publix be open Easter 2026?Publix stores will be closed on Easter, as the company closes for Thanksgiving, Christmas and Easter each year so associates can enjoy the holidays with family and friends.Will Kroger be open on Easter?Kroger stores will be open on Easter Sunday during their regular business hours.Will Aldi be open on Easter?All Aldi store locations will be closed on Easter Sunday.Will Trader Joe’s be open on Easter?Trader Joe’s locations will be open on Easter Sunday during their regular business hours.Will Whole Foods be open on Easter?Whole Foods will be open on Easter Sunday during regular business hours. Check your local store’s Whole Foods page for details.What stores are closed on Easter Sunday?In observance of Easter Sunday and to allow staff time off for the holiday, the following stores will be closed:Best BuyHobby LobbyDick’s Sporting GoodsKohl’sLowe’sT.J. MaxxHomeGoodsMichaelsWhat stores are open on Easter Sunday?These stores will be open on Easter Sunday, but may operate with reduced hours. Check your local store before heading out. Home DepotBass Pro ShopsWalgreensPetSmartJennifer Lindahl is a Breaking and Trending Reporter in Alabama for USA TODAY’s Deep South Connect Team.
